facts.business: Rajputana Biodiesel Limited manufactures biodiesel from non-edible oils and waste-based feedstock, and is expanding into Compressed Biogas (CBG) and biomass briquettes to become an integrated bioenergy company.

capacity_or_capex.item: Two CBG units approved in Ajmer and Nagaur, Rajasthan

key_risks: Fossil fuel dependence and low biodiesel blending rates in India
Policy ambition vs supply readiness gap
Urban air quality and crude import costs
Dependence on non-edible oil and waste feedstock availability
facts.related_party_note: Unsecured loans provided to subsidiaries (Rs 1,293.98 lakhs during FY2026, outstanding Rs 1,523.85 lakhs as on 31 March 2026) and others (Rs 129.52 lakhs during FY2026, outstanding Rs 103.78 lakhs). Terms not prejudicial to company's interest. No schedule of repayment for advances in nature of loans.
